Scheme Name: Mahila Udyam Pragati Subsidy (Sample)
Department: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (sample, illustrative)

About the scheme
This scheme offers a capital subsidy on bank loans to women who start or grow a small business.

Benefits
- 25 percent capital subsidy on the project loan, up to Rs 1.25 lakh.
- Collateral-free loans up to Rs 5 lakh.

Who can apply
- Applicant must be a woman.
- Applicant must be aged between 18 and 55 years.
- Applicant must be an entrepreneur starting or running a small enterprise.
- Annual family income should be below Rs 5 lakh.
- Applicant must belong to SC, ST, OBC or EWS category.

Not eligible
- Applicants with an unpaid loan default with any bank.

Documents required
- Aadhaar card
- Income certificate
- Caste certificate
- Detailed project report

Application procedure
1. Prepare a short project report with the expected cost.
2. Apply at a partner bank branch or the district industries centre.
3. The bank reviews the proposal and sanctions the loan.
